properties.notes: Outline planning permission granted for 578 units (14/00865/OUT) in January 2015. Reserved matters consent for the full 578 units (15/03667/RES) was granted in May 2016. Work has commenced on site and the first 12 units were completed in 2016/17. Delivery projections are based upon starts on site (91 units under construction at April 2017 with a further 35 started April to Jun 2017. 45 units were completed by June 17). 56 of the units are to be delivered in the existing 'white building' and an application to increase this to 96 units (17/02279/FUL) is currently being considered.. Erection of up to 578 dwellings inc conversion of white building
